question: Rohan divides his complete journey in three equal parts and covers the first part at a speed of 30 km/h, the second part at 40 km/h and the last part at 50 km/h with his car. What is the average speed (in km/h) of his car during his entire journey?
solution:
**Given:**

Rohan divides his journey into three equal parts.

Speed during the first part (v1) = 30 km/h

Speed during the second part (v2) = 40 km/h

Speed during the third part (v3) = 50 km/h

**Calculation:**

v_avg = 3/(1/30 + 1/40 + 1/50)

Average = (3 × 300)/(10 + 7.5 + 6)
